item.title: Former Johnson County Judge Barred From Bench After OWI Verdict
item.description: The Indiana Supreme Court has barred a former Johnson County judge from practicing law after he was convicted of a felony offense related to impaired driving.

item.title: Indiana Ranks Among States With Lowest Household Income Growth
item.description: Household incomes have grown in nearly every state over the past 50 years, but a new study concludes that growth has been uneven across the country.

item.title: Pavilion Help Center Newly Formed Nonprofit Serving Kosciusko County
item.description: The Pavilion Help Center recently convened its board of directors as the organization begins operations as an independent nonprofit dedicated to improving access to health care for Kosciusko County residents.

item.title: Limited Edition Coke Cans Celebrate IU National Championship
item.description: Coca-Cola is rolling out limited-edition cans across central and southern Indiana to commemorate Indiana University’s first national championship in football.

item.title: Participants Brave The Chill For The Annual Polar Plunge in Syracuse
item.description: It was a cold winter’s day in Syracuse Saturday, Jan. 31, appropriate for Oakwood Resort’s 8th annual polar plunge.

item.title: Medicaid Fraud Case Involving Former Hoosier Physician Reaches $1.7M Settlement
item.description: The U.S. Department of Justice has reached a $1.7 million settlement with a former Indiana physician to resolve allegations that he submitted thousands of fraudulent claims to the Indiana Medicaid program, federal officials announced.

item.title: Bravo Trailers Shuts Down, Bank Granted Control Of Property
item.description: First State Bank of Middlebury has been granted temporary control of a commercial building after the tenant fell behind on mortgage payments and faced a potential heat shutoff during extreme winter weather.

item.title: Mentone Man Turns Self In On Child Sex Abuse Material Possession, Voyeurism Charges
item.description: A Mentone man was recently arrested following an investigation on multiple cybertips regarding crimes against children.

item.title: A $1,400 Frigidaire cooktop catastrophe
item.description: A noisy, cracked induction cooktop from Frigidaire leaves Linda Lockwood chasing repairs, dealing with missed appointments and getting the runaround from both the manufacturer and Best Buy.
